AddonDescription: Shows which files are new, changed or staged right in the file list, and lets you add them to git from the context menu.
GitInitConfirm: Initialize a new git repository here?
GitDiscardConfirm: Discard all uncommitted changes to the selected items? This cannot be undone.
SettingBadgeLettersHint: U, M, A and ! instead of a plain colored dot
SettingFoldersHint: Folders show the most important status of the files inside them
SettingUntracked: Mark files not added to git
